actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Since Resident1 contributed more than 30 units in the last round, I must punish them with the maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/punishment_cost)=694). I also broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

message.reasoning: We need to follow rules. Last round history round2 contributions: Resident1 64.2 (>30), Resident3 64.2, Resident4 64.2. So there is a resident contributed >30, we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet 208.4, punishment_cost 0.3, max severity = floor(208.4/0.3)= floor(694.666)=694. But severity is amount field? punish amount is severity units, cost = severity * punishment_cost. Must have enough wallet. 694*0.3=208.2 <=208.4, okay. Choose target? Any resident contributed >30, could pick any. Probably pick Resident1 as first. So punish Resident1 amount 694. Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So two actions: punish and broadcast. Explanation.
